entries.note: Yuki 1994 (PMID 7825169) abstract read; quote is its closing sentence; Ppa dose-dependently suppressed over 3 weeks. Opening untested entry correct.

Galie 2002 quote verbatim (abstract). Rubin 1990 (PMID 2107780) epoprostenol RCT lowered pulmonary resistance before Yuki 1994: retrodiction true; failed to reproduce, so contra stands. Beraprost, oral, unselected PAH correct.
Rowlands 2016 AJRCCM A2220: full abstract page did not render; telemetry sentence confirmed via search snippet, anti-remodeling sentence not seen directly. Opening untested entry fine.

NCT02927366 results posted 2019-08-07; 'Only descriptive analysis performed.' in PVR outcome description. Day-111 PVR ratio 1.07 is n=4 QCC374 (6 randomized) vs 2 placebo; note says n=6. Unsettled is right.
Yuki 1994 abstract gives drinking-water concentrations only, no human exposure or margin; beraprost and ralinepag titrated to tolerability. untested/no_prediction correct.
Rowlands abstract states rat window only, no human dose; FIH NCT02245828 basis not published. untested/unpublished acceptable (no_prediction would also fit).
Same Yuki 1994 sentence; opening untested entry correct.
Galie 2002 6MWD quote verbatim; 6MWD was the primary endpoint. Rubin 1990 predates Yuki 1994, so retro is right. Beraprost, oral, unselected PAH.

Barst 2003 quote verbatim; primary (disease progression) not sustained, authors say effect attenuates: contra. Retrodiction true per Rubin 1990. Note fixed, but 'short' still calls the trial BEAT; Barst 2003 is unnamed (BEAT is esuberaprost).
Rowlands 2016; anti-remodeling sentence not seen verbatim (page did not render), telemetry sentence of same abstract confirmed. Opening untested fine.
NCT02927366 primary PVR week 16, descriptive only; registry caveat says no meaningful comparison possible. untested/unsettled correct; QCC374 n at week 16 is 4, not 6.
Telemetered-rat no-sBP-change sentence confirmed near-verbatim via search snippet of the abstract PDF. Opening untested correct.

Registry AE table: headache 5/6, flushing 3/6, jaw pain 2/6, syncope 1/6 on QCC374, 0/2 placebo; no hypotension term. Quote is the PVR descriptive caveat, not an AE sentence, but status untested/unsettled is right.
Sim 1985 (PMID 3913423) abstract read; quote verbatim. Opening untested entry at model_first_use_year 1985 correct; class level, beraprost itself in model.

Demolis 1993 (PMID 7506323) quote verbatim in abstract. O'Grady 1980 (PMID 6992228): IV prostacyclin gave ex vivo platelet inhibition in volunteers, before Sim 1985 (PMID 3913423): retro correct. Oral, volunteers, direct readout fit.
Shen 2019 (PMID 31158340, epub 2019-05-31) abstract: quote verbatim. Opening untested entry fine, but the model paper postdates the 8 Apr 2019 BEAT topline press release (see index 7).

UT press release dated 8 Apr 2019 confirms BEAT missed primary; Shen 2019 epub 31 May 2019: year 2019, retrodiction true. Registry title confirms add-on to inhaled treprostinil, FC III/IV on it: stage_or_line right. Esuberaprost is beraprost-314d, oral. Registry quote is weak support; press release carries it.

entries.rule: Pairing: a prospective model prediction later matched by the patient result is same (model 1994 precedes the 2002 trial, so not retro)
entries.note: Quote verbatim in Yuki 1994 abstract (PMID 7825169). Galie 2002 full text (JACC, doi:10.1016/S0735-1097(02)01786-2) states 'the safety profile of the drug was excellent with neither systemic hypotension'; hypotension data were reported, so not unsettled: add paired same, 2002.
entries.adjudication_note: Pairing rule (rule 1, comparison_stated false): Yuki 1994 'Psa was not lowered' vs Galie 2002 JACC full text 'neither systemic hypotension' (verified). Prospective; 1994 opener stays untested, track becomes same in 2002.

entries.note: Yuki 1994 abstract: 'Psa was not lowered dose-dependently by BPS' confirmed. Galie 2002 Discussion sentence not reachable (full text blocked); abstract reports no hypotension. Same 2002 for beraprost, oral, unselected; retrodiction question remains open (prior rule question).
Tran 2017 (PMID 28072531, epub Jan 2017) quote verbatim. Opener untested 2017 on ralinepag/oral track, same mct-rat model_id fields.
Torres 2019 quote verbatim; Arena topline 10 Jul 2017 confirmed (drugs.com history, BioPharma Dive); registry results 2020-07-14 (NCT02279160). Retro per Rubin 1990. Ralinepag, oral, unselected.
Tran 2017 quote verbatim; untested opener for ralinepag oral track, year 2017 matches epub.
Torres 2019: primary was PVR change, met (p=0.02); topline 10 Jul 2017 sets year; retro per Rubin 1990. outcome_tested positive from ADVANCE OUTCOMES in patient_trials; status follows surrogate.

missing: Engagement, mct-rat track: Saji/Ichida-type short-term haemodynamic study of oral beraprost, Am J Cardiol 1996, doi:10.1016/s0002-9149(96)90408-7 (PMID 8712155): PVR fell 24% in 4 PPH patients. A paired same entry (1996) before the 2002 contra; latest status unchanged.

Safety, mct-rat track: Yuki 1994 (doi:10.1620/tjem.173.371) states 'Psa was not lowered dose-dependently by BPS' - a no-systemic-hypotension prediction for beraprost with no safety track; Galie 2002/Barst 2003 AE data could pair with it.

Ralinepag's own MCT rat data: Tran 2017 J Med Chem (PMID 28072531) 'oral efficacy in the rat monocrotaline model' - cited only in judgement/confidence_note; could be named as model_src for the ralinepag patient_trials (same mct-rat model_id).
Ralinepag ADVANCE CAPACITY (NCT04084678) terminated for 'Sponsor decision' - no efficacy failure, does not change status.

Efficacy, pah-pasmc-human-pa-exvivo track: United Therapeutics press release 2019-04-08 'BEAT Study of Esuberaprost Does Not Meet Primary Endpoint' (https://ir.unither.com/press-releases/2019/04-08-2019-145624946; tier 5) - BEAT failure public before Shen 2019, making the ex vivo pairing a retrodiction; also CHEST 2019 abstract (journal.chestnet.org S0012-3692(19)32994-0).

Safety, mct-rat track: Galie 2002 ALPHABET full text (doi:10.1016/S0735-1097(02)01786-2, Discussion): 'Despite the high doses of beraprost sodium used in this study, the safety profile of the drug was excellent with neither systemic hypotension nor hepatic, renal or hematologic side effects.' Pairs with Yuki 1994 no-Psa-fall prediction as a same entry (2002), product_in_model true.
rule_questions: Efficacy 3: BEAT's 12-month primary failed because benefit attenuated over time; the MCT rat studies were 3-week designs. Is treatment duration a 'condition the model never tested' (-> untested) or is a model's benefit claim implicitly a durable-benefit claim (-> contra)?
Engagement 2: is an uncontrolled acute haemodynamic series (1996) admissible as a same entry before the controlled 2002 null, and should engagement use only controlled comparisons?

Safety 4: beraprost was in Japanese patients (chronic arterial occlusion, approved 1992; stroke study PMID 2057914, 1991) and healthy volunteers (Demolis 1993) before Yuki 1994. Does a same-drug result in another disease or in volunteers make a safety model a retrodiction, and does it count if no hypotension finding is quoted?
